purpose: Modern Nintendo 3DS eShop-inspired visual concepts. Images are mockups, not implemented UI; native catalog browsing and richer companion details are proposed designs.

prompts.name: 01-browse
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity raster UI design concept for ThorShelf, an Android gaming companion used on a landscape handheld.
Primary request: a modern UI inspired by the original Nintendo 3DS eShop. Keep the nostalgic cheerful orange-and-ivory identity, floating square game artwork, subtle dotted-paper texture, rounded tactile controls and playful parcel imagery, but use contemporary typography, generous spacing, superb alignment and minimal clutter. This should look like a carefully art-directed, plausible shipping app screen, not a generic dashboard or wireframe.
Visual system: warm off-white #FAF8F2 background; white surfaces; vibrant tangerine #F58821 navigation accents and controller focus outline; dark warm charcoal readable text; subtle pale grey dividers; small green status accents. Crisp rounded humanist sans serif, strong typographic hierarchy, large accessible labels and controls. Tasteful soft shadows and tiny highlights, no heavy skeuomorphism. Selected items have a clean orange 3px double-outline focus treatment with a little breathing room.
Brand text must be exactly "ThorShelf", never Nintendo eShop as the app name. Make a simple original orange shelf/bag icon beside ThorShelf. The user is asking for design concepts, not a replica storefront.
Keep all listed text legible and correctly spelled. No watermarks, no designer annotations, no extraneous lorem ipsum, no financial charts, no browser chrome, no literal desktop computer. Game artwork is illustrative sample artwork for the mockup. No prices, shopping cart, purchase buttons, or invented star ratings.
Composition: single edge-to-edge landscape application screen, 16:9 aspect, rendered flat and straight-on at high resolution, no device frame. Aim for a clean premium handheld UI with one striking colorful hero and a pleasing row of cover art.
Top bar: ThorShelf logo at left; centered rounded segmented navigation "Browse", "Downloads" with tiny badge "2", "Setup". Browse selected on an orange pill. Small Wi-Fi symbol and battery indicator at right.
Below: large title "Your next adventure." on the left and a rounded search field "Search the catalog" with a small "Y" controller button on the right.
Main featured area: a wide rounded pale peach feature card, left half showing small label "ON THE SHELF", large beautifully set title "Pokémon Omega Ruby", compact subtitle "Nintendo 3DS · Adventure", and a clearly focused orange button "View game". Right half contains polished vibrant ruby-red game-inspired Groudon artwork with a sunny tropical landscape, art softly integrated into the card. Restrict the hero to roughly a third of screen height so the catalog stays useful.
Below hero: small neutral rounded category chips "All games" selected, "Updates", "DLC", "Virtual Console".
Bottom content row: four evenly sized beautiful rounded square artwork tiles with compact titles beneath: "Animal Crossing", "Mario Kart 7", "Professor Layton", "A Link Between Worlds". Illustrations should suggest their games distinctly: cozy village, bright kart race, gentleman in top hat with mysterious golden mask, emerald fantasy adventure. This is a shelf of equal game tiles with consistent thumbnail crops, not a statistics dashboard.
Bottom fixed thin hint strip: "A Select" · "B Back" · "L / R Tabs" · "Y Search", icons styled like small controller buttons, plus discreet "hShop catalog" at far right.
Excellent spacing, everything fits fully inside the frame with no clipped text.

Composition: single edge-to-edge landscape application screen, 16:9 aspect, flat straight-on high-resolution screenshot, no device frame.
Top bar: ThorShelf logo at left; centered rounded navigation "Browse", "Downloads" with badge "2", "Setup". Downloads selected orange. Small Wi-Fi and battery glyphs right.
Page heading "Downloads" with subtitle "A little closer to your next adventure." and a small outlined "Wi-Fi only" indicator on the right.
Content has a spacious two-column layout: left about 60% width with three white horizontal list rows, right about 35% width with a taller peach preparation card. Minimal outlined borders, restrained shadows. Each row has an attractive square game artwork thumbnail, title, status, and a clear appropriate action.
Row 1: "Animal Crossing: New Leaf", status "Downloading · 64%", wide thin orange progress bar, smaller detail "512 MB of 800 MB", subtle "Cancel" text button. No pause button.
Row 2: "Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask", green check and status "Downloaded", prominent outlined button "Prepare for Azahar" with orange focus outline, smaller "Save a copy" action. Artwork shows a gentleman in a top hat and a mysterious golden mask.
Row 3: "Mario Kart 7", green check and status "Ready for Azahar", simple "Open Azahar" button. Artwork is a vivid racing kart.
Right card: small heading "PREPARING", handsome playful isometric orange paper parcel with tiny luminous squares floating into it, borrowing the joyful feel of the original eShop download animation. Large title "Pokémon Omega Ruby", text "Preparing for Azahar", a smooth orange progress bar labeled "72%", and small secondary text "Saving to your games folder". Footer of card has subtle "Cancel" control. No launch game button.
Bottom fixed thin strip: "A Select" · "B Back" · "L / R Tabs" · "Y Search". Keep text readable at handheld size, no extra panels or complicated controls, no low-level technical processing labels.

Asset type refinement: polished dual-screen UI concept presentation, showing how the main Browse screen and the separate Companion display belong together.
Composition: landscape 3:2 design board on a very pale warm grey background. Show exactly two flat front-facing screen surfaces, no physical device or hinges, no perspective distortion. A large wide landscape primary screen across the upper two thirds, and a compact near-square companion screen aligned below its center. The primary screen is about twice the width of the companion. Keep both fully in frame with thin softly rounded dark-grey display borders and very soft shadows. This is a UI presentation; focus on detailed crisp screens, not surrounding hardware. No extra screen thumbnails.
Upper screen: warm white ThorShelf UI, compact top navigation "Browse", "Downloads", "Setup", Browse selected orange. Left of main content: vivid square "Professor Layton" sample art of a gentleman in a top hat beside a gold theatrical mask on a purple sunset city backdrop, plus two small landscape screenshot thumbnails underneath. Right of content: eyebrow "NINTENDO 3DS", large title "Professor Layton and the Miracle Mask", metadata "North America · Puzzle", concise description "A new mystery awaits.", orange primary button "View catalog page" with strong controller focus outline. Footer hints "A Select" · "B Back" · "L / R Tabs" · "Y Search". The primary screen should feel focused, quiet and beautifully spaced.
Lower screen: the actual passive companion status view. Top line ThorShelf icon and "Companion". Large warm orange central parcel illustration with a few glowing square pixels floating down into the box. Under it title "Getting things ready", then compact line "Pokémon Omega Ruby" and rounded progress bar "72%". Below, two neat small status areas "1 downloading" and "1 preparing", then a small clear line "On main screen: Professor Layton". Use the same warm white, orange and charcoal styling. No buttons on this passive status screen.
No long annotations around the screens. Typography, focus treatment, corner radii and colors should match across both screens. Attractive negative space on the design board, but screens must be large enough to read.
